shortDescription: Create, update, or delete VAST Tenant resources

options.name: access_ip_ranges
options.description:
Restricts tenant login access to specified source IP ranges. Enter as single IPs (1.1.1.1), ranges (1.2.3.4 -
1.2.3.6), or CIDR (1.1.1.0/24).

options.name: ad_provider_id
options.description: Active Directory provider ID

options.name: allow_disabled_users
options.description: Allow IO from users whose Active Directory accounts are explicitly disabled.

options.name: allow_locked_users
options.description:
Allow IO from users whose Active Directory accounts are locked out by lockout policies due to unsuccessful login
attempts.

options.name: allowed_delegations
options.description: Defines the possible types of NFSv4 delegations

options.name: application_users_group_name
options.description: The name of the group that will be used for application users

options.name: capacity_rules
options.description: Capacity Rules

options.name: client_ip_ranges
options.description:
Array of ranges of client IPs to be served by the tenant. For client requests made to a VIP that belongs to a VIP
Pool that is not associated to a specific tenant, the client's source IP is checked against the Client IPs that
are defined within each tenant. That check determines access. The client IPs that you associate with each tenant
must be unique per tenant.

options.name: data_engine_role_enabled
options.description: Whether to create dedicated Role for application users group

options.name: data_engine_s3_policy_enabled
options.description: Whether to create dedicated Identity Policy for application users group

options.name: default_others_share_level_perm
options.description: Default Share-level permissions for Others

options.name: domain_name
options.description: Domain name to incorporate into the VMS tenant login page URL.

options.name: encryption_crn
options.description: Tenant's encryption group unique identifier (deprecated)

options.name: encryption_group
options.description: Tenant's encryption group unique identifier

options.name: force_remove
options.description: Forces deletion of the tenant, even if files exist in the tenant directory. (only used when state=absent)

options.name: grant_unrequested_delegations_by_default
options.description:
When enabled, the server may grant delegations based on share access even if not explicitly requested by the
client

options.name: id
options.description: Resource ID for direct lookup. Mutually exclusive with name-based identification.

options.name: identity_provider_name
options.description:
Sets a configured SAML login provider to enable for the tenant. When set, users defined on the specified SAML
provider can login to the tenant VMS as tenant admin users.

options.name: is_nfsv42_supported
options.description: Enable NFSv4.2

options.name: krb_provider_id
options.description: Kerberos provider ID

options.name: ldap_provider_id
options.description: Open-LDAP provider ID specified separately by the user

options.name: local_provider_id
options.description: Local provider ID

options.name: login_name_primary_provider
options.description: Login name primary provider type

options.name: max_views
options.description: Max views we can create on this tenant (0:unlimted as default)

options.name: mtls_identifier
options.description: The mTLS identifier of the tenant Requires VMS 5.5 or later.

options.name: name
options.description: A name for the tenant

options.name: nis_provider_id
options.description: NIS provider ID

options.name: oidc_provider_id
options.description: OIDC provider ID

options.name: posix_primary_provider
options.description: POSIX primary provider type

options.name: preferred_owning_group
options.description: Set to prefer GID of the user as the owning group of the file

options.name: qos
options.description: Qos

options.name: require_smb_signing
options.description: Require SMB signing

options.name: smb_administrators_group_name
options.description:
Optional custom name to specify a non default privileged group. If not set, privileged group is the Backup
Operators domain group.

options.name: smb_encryption_state
options.description: Defines the encryption level for SMB

options.name: smb_privileged_group_full_access
options.description:
True=The SMB privileged user group has read and write control access. Members of the group can perform backup and
restore operations on all files and directories, without requiring read or write access to the specific files and
directories. False=the privileged group has read only access.

options.name: smb_privileged_group_sid
options.description:
Optional custom SID to specify a non default SMB privileged group. If not set, SMB privileged group is the Backup
Operators domain group.

options.name: smb_privileged_user_name
options.description: Optional custom username for the SMB privileged user. If not set, the SMB privileged user name is 'vastadmin'

options.name: state
options.description: Desired state of the resource.

options.name: tenant_admins_group_name
options.description:
Specifies a group on an AD or LDAP provider. Enables users in the group to log into the tenant VMS as Tenant
Admin users. In order to be granted permissions to do any configuration, the same users need to belong to groups
on the provider that are associated with VMS manager user roles for tenant admin type users on the tenant.

options.name: trash_gid
options.description: GID with permissions to the trash folder

options.name: use_smb_native
options.description: Use native SMB authentication

options.name: use_smb_privileged_group
options.description: Enables SMB privileged user group

options.name: use_smb_privileged_user
options.description: Enables SMB privileged user

options.name: vms
options.description: VAST VMS connection parameters.

options.name: wait
options.description: Wait for async operations to complete.

options.name: wait_timeout
options.description: Timeout in seconds for async operations.
